claude.performance_metric: FY2012 $946.5M patent-sale gain; net income $(782.5)M→$13.1M→$1,048.4M→$92.4M (2010-13); Patch fully impaired ($17.5M) and divested into Hale Global JV by early 2014
claude.rationale: p4=1: the slice documents realized product/operations incoherence over time — the Patch hyperlocal-content product "could not be sustained within the operation," triggering a $17.5M full goodwill impairment and 2013 restructuring "to align our organizational structure with our strategy, including the restructuring of our Patch operations," culminating in Patch's divestiture into a Hale Global-controlled JV; the subscription-access product also eroded steadily (3.3M→2.5M subscribers). p5=uncertain: the slice references organizational-structure realignment but does not document a specific fracture at the operations-vs-people/management/culture interface. t1 and t2=uncertain: this is a post-separation single-company outcome slice with no documented evidence about a controlling-intent archetype or reconciliation of two business models.

gemini.performance_metric: net income (loss) of $(782.5)M (2010) to $92.4M (2013) with full write-off and divestiture of Patch
gemini.rationale: The slice documents product/process disruption (p4) as the Patch hyperlocal-content product could not be sustained within the operation, leading to a $17.5 million goodwill impairment and its contribution to a joint venture. There is no documented evidence of a fracture specifically at the process/organization interface (p5).

grok.performance_metric: NI $(782.5)M (2010)→$92.4M (2013); $1.41bn goodwill impairment; Patch fully impaired and JV-divested
grok.rationale: p4=1 because the slice documents product/operations incoherence: the Patch hyperlocal-content product 'could not be sustained within the operation,' triggering a $17.5M full goodwill impairment, 2013 restructuring 'of our Patch operations,' and contribution of Patch into a Hale Global-controlled JV with AOL retaining only a minority stake; subscription-access product erosion (subscribers 3.3M→2.5M; revenues $803.2M→$650.1M) is also recorded. p5=0 because the slice records no fracture at the process/organization interface (no operations-vs-people/management/culture breakdown); the noted restructuring is framed only as aligning structure with strategy around Patch, not as organizational integration failure.
